```yaml
name: Replay Benchmark

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly on Sunday at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest pre-commit

      - name: Check environment
        run: |
          python check_env.py --auto-install

      - name: Run replay benchmark
        run: |
          python scripts/run_replay_bench.py

      - name: Update benchmark history
        run: |
          # Move the benchmark results to docs directory
          mkdir -p docs
          mv benchmark_results.csv docs/bench_history.csv

      - name: Commit benchmark results
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add docs/bench_history.csv
          git commit -m "Update benchmark results" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}

  badge:
    needs: benchmark
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate badge
        run: |
          # Create badge showing last benchmark date
          echo "![Benchmark Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/benchmark-up_to_date-green)" > badge.svg

      - name: Upload badge
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: badge
          path: badge.svg
```
